item.title: Fuzhou Habourview Fliport Resort — 2 Nights, Zero Holiday Surcharge
item.description:
Deal price: ¥729 (≈$101) (was ¥1,028) · No coupon needed — zero National Day surcharge · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

Two nights in a seaside resort with zero holiday surcharge is rare — Habourview Fliport is holding the line for Mid-Autumn and National Day. You get a high-floor standard twin room, breakfast for 2 adults + 2 kids, a sea-view mini train, and 10+ free activities.

item.title: Huihe Stone Culture Park — Opera, Tea & Gardens
item.description:
Deal price: ¥21 (≈$3) (was ¥58) · ¥20 off orders over ¥20 → as low as ¥1! · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

A slow afternoon done right: sip tea by the fountain lake, watch traditional Hui’an women’s-culture and ‘Stone Woman’ performances, catch a puppet show, and let the kids loose on the big lawn. With the coupon it can cost as little as ¥1.

item.title: Langham Place Xiamen — Executive Room Package
item.description:
Deal price: ¥699 (≈$97) (was ¥1,388) · ¥100 off orders over ¥601 → as low as ¥599 (≈$83) · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

Langham’s executive package is built for families who want the lounge life: an executive room for the night, breakfast for 2 adults + 1 child, executive lounge privileges, and a ¥100 dining voucher. The National Day surcharge is small and the coupon takes the edge off.

item.title: Xiamen Airlines Fairmont Hotel Buffet
item.description:
Deal price: ¥268 (≈$37) (was ¥468) · ¥50 off orders over ¥151 → lunch ¥218, dinner ¥318 · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

The Fairmont’s buffet is one of Xiamen’s most generous spreads, and the National Day subsidy makes it genuinely good value. Lunch comes with a caviar giveaway; dinner adds tomahawk steak and a dessert course (Napoleon or rice-wine egg).

item.title: Xiamen Fliport Wutong Hotel — Ocean-View Room + Private Beach
item.description:
Deal price: ¥859 (≈$119) (was ¥2,388) · ¥100 off orders over ¥601 → from ¥759 (≈$105) · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

Perched on Wuyuan Bay with a private beach, the Fliport Wutong is Xiamen’s classic seaside splurge — and the National Day price is far below rack rate. The package bundles a luxury ocean-view room with breakfast for two and afternoon tea for two.

item.title: Yuehua Hotel Buffet — Xiamen Family Favorite
item.description:
Deal price: ¥169 (≈$23) (was ¥240) · ¥50 off orders over ¥151 → lunch ¥119, dinner ¥179 · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

Yuehua pairs a solid hotel buffet with a huge garden the kids can run around in — the combo parents actually want. One ticket covers 1 adult + 1 child (under 1.3m), and there’s no holiday surcharge over National Day.

item.title: Yujian Minnan Cultural Show — 1 Adult + 1 Child
item.description:
Deal price: ¥188 (≈$26) (was ¥286) · ¥40 off orders over ¥101 → as low as ¥148 (≈$20) · ⏰ National Day special — ends Oct 7

Yujian Minnan is Xiamen’s love letter to its own culture — and the ‘Gulangyu Homecoming Season’ adds a new themed show, garden treasure hunts and full-park NPC interactions. One ticket covers 1 adult + 1 child (ages 6–13).
